title: 第9章 斩杀先天第10章 苍阳城杨家
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 赵元就犹如是帝王一般，高高在上俯瞰着李轩，如同俯瞰蝼蚁。
君临天下，霸气十足。
听着他那霸道的话语，赵家外那些人无不心惊胆颤。
他们看着赵元，就犹如是在面对天生的上位者，根本生不起任何反抗的念头。
君临天下，唯我独尊。
赵元就好像是神明，无敌的存在，不可战胜。
而那些侥幸未死的赵家人，则是在短暂的沉寂后，再次忍不住发出了惊天动地的欢呼之音。
“赵公子无敌！”
“少主无敌！”
“杀了李轩，杀了李轩！”
他们是真的很激动，连带着那看向李轩的眼神，都没有了先前的恐惧。
他们似乎都已经看到，李轩被打倒在地上，卑微如狗的样子。
“嗤嗤嗤！”
然而，就在那些赵家人激动之时，一道剑芒忽然亮起，下一秒，数十颗脑袋再次飞了起来。
所有声音戛然而止，凡是那些叫的，都被送下了黄泉。
静。
死一般的静。
谁都没有想到，都这种时候了，李轩竟然还敢杀。
他疯了吗？
赵公子就在不远处看着呢啊。
他怎么敢？
赵元瞳孔也是忍不住猛地一缩，眼中爆发出了森然杀机。
李轩看向赵元，不屑道：“你不装比会死吗？难道你就不想问问，我为何杀这些人？”
“不重要。”赵元冷冷盯着李轩，“杀我赵家人，就已经注定了你的下场。”
“你区区炼气境八重，竟然也敢如此挑衅我赵家，挑衅我赵元，你该死！”
“现在我就让你看看，什么是先天！”
伴随着声音，先天境一重的强大气息彻底暴走，赵元抬起一只手，就朝着李轩镇压了过去。
一道由先天罡气凝聚的掌印瞬间成型，掀起隆隆之音，轰地一声镇压向李轩。
那道掌印给人的感觉，就犹如是一座大山，重若千钧。
“让我知道什么是先天？”
李轩看着那道由先天罡气凝聚成的掌印，则是忍不住笑了。
不讲道理吗？
他喜欢！
说真的，要不是被打入此界，开始了重修，他还真是早已经忘记了先天是个什么境界。
这个赵元，凭借一道先天罡气掌印，竟然就想要镇压他李轩，果真是装比到了极致。
content_en:
Zhao Yuan was like an emperor, looking down at Li Xuan like an ant.
Dominate the world and be full of domineering power.
Listening to his domineering words, those outside the Zhao family were all frightened.
They looked at Zhao Yuan as if they were facing a natural superior, and could not think of any resistance at all.
I am the only one who rules over the world.
Zhao Yuan is like a god, an invincible existence, invincible.
Those Zhao family members who were lucky enough to survive could not help but let out earth-shattering cheers again after a brief silence.
"Master Zhao is invincible!"
"Young Master is invincible!"
"Kill Li Xuan, kill Li Xuan!"
They were really excited, and even the fear in their eyes when they looked at Li Xuan was gone.
They all seemed to have seen Li Xuan being knocked to the ground, looking as humble as a dog.
"Tsk tsk tsk!"
However, just when the Zhao family members were excited, a sword light suddenly lit up, and the next second, dozens of heads flew up again.
All sounds stopped suddenly, and those who screamed were sent to hell.
quiet.
Deadly quiet.
No one thought that at this time, Li Xuan would dare to kill.
Is he crazy?
Mr. Zhao is watching not far away.
How dare he?
Zhao Yuan's pupils couldn't help but shrink suddenly, and murderous intent burst out in his eyes.
Li Xuan looked at Zhao Yuan and said disdainfully: "Don't you pretend to know how to die? Don't you want to ask why I killed these people?"
"It's not important." Zhao Yuan stared at Li Xuan coldly, "Killing my Zhao family will already determine your fate."
"You are only at the eighth level of the Qi Refining Realm, but you dare to provoke my Zhao family and Zhao Yuan like this. You deserve to die!"
"Now I will show you what innateness is!"
Along with the sound, the powerful aura of the first level of Xiantian Realm completely went berserk. Zhao Yuan raised a hand and suppressed it towards Li Xuan.
A palm print condensed by the innate energy was instantly formed, making a rumbling sound and suppressing Li Xuan with a bang.
That palm print feels like a huge mountain, as heavy as a thousand pieces.
"Tell me what innateness is?"
Li Xuan couldn't help but smile when he looked at the palm print formed by the condensed innate energy.
Unreasonable?
He likes it!
To be honest, if he hadn't been thrown into this realm and started rebuilding, he would have forgotten what the innate realm was.
This Zhao Yuan actually wanted to suppress Li Xuan with the help of an innate Gangqi palm seal. He was really pretending to the extreme.
